decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY fully captures the required footer identifiers for RR02, RR03, and RR04; the prior RR-01 value remains applicable to RR01.
The existing same-message MODIFY fully captures the version-specific header identifiers; the earlier RR-01 header example remains valid for RR01.
The exposure-band correction is independently and completely represented by the candidate's existing same-message MODIFY.
Correcting report identifiers does not change the accepted premium visual style or refinement priorities.
The report ID remains an editable customer field; correcting the identifier displayed by each report variant does not alter field editability.
The identifier corrections do not change the required content, detail level, or presentation of the front-page result explanation.
The dashboard must still display the same result fields with the same prominence; report identifier corrections do not alter this behavior.
Version-specific report identifiers do not change the warning's presence, visual treatment, message, or footer-interference constraint.
The same four editable report variants and delivery-format requirements remain required; correcting their displayed identifiers does not change the template deliverable.
The report identifier corrections do not affect the required fonts, icons, design assets, or their intended reuse.
